options.content:
# Reconstruction error

Demonstrates the difference between expected behaviour and actual behaviour for each device

spec.query:
from(bucket: "MLCL1")
  |> range(start: -14d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lstm_anomaly")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "reconstruction_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "Client1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
